_comment: MetaChat config: METACHAT_CONFIG (env) else ~/.config/metachat/config.json. Every key is optional; a missing file means these defaults. Keys of the wrong type are ignored. Keys starting with _ are notes. No real names here: desk names are data.
_port: TCP port every bind address listens on
_bind: one listener per address, e.g. ["127.0.0.1", "192.0.2.10"]; an address that cannot bind is retried every 5 s
_allowed_hosts: Host header values accepted, e.g. ["192.0.2.10:8460"]; empty = each bind address with :port plus localhost:port; others get 403 bad host
_state_dir: token, logs, desks/, accounts/, prompts/, history.sqlite, modules/ (0700); METACHAT_STATE (env) overrides it
_inbox_module: an inbox adapter: the absolute path of a .py file defining make_inbox(ctx) (see src/metabot_app/inbox.py); it adds a chat service of your own beside typing into the terminal. Empty = none. A missing or broken file logs one line and the app runs without one. An adapter reads its own keys from this file
_default_desk: the desk that gets messages without a 'for <desk>: ' prefix, sorts first, and can never be killed; e.g. "desk-a"
_shared_desk: the tmux session the terminal opens when no desk is named (desks themselves are fc-<name>)
_tmux_socket: the app's own tmux server (tmux -L <name>), so it never touches sessions you started yourself; "" = your default tmux server
_claude_homes: Claude config folders under HOME whose transcripts Resume and the reply mirror read, e.g. [".claude", ".claude-work"]
_claude_name_prefixes: a desk whose name starts with one of these is a Claude desk when its pane is idle or absent, e.g. ["claude", "desk-"]
_binaries: empty = the metabot and orcha installed beside the app (then the first on PATH), and the app's own interpreter; a path may start with ~; set one to pin a particular install
_metabot_home: empty = MetaBot's own rule ($METABOT_HOME else ~/.metabot); every spawned desk gets METABOT_HOME pinned to the resolved value
_projects: a desk or run whose cwd is under a path belongs to that project; anything else is project 'other'
_project_roots: folders a tablet-chosen cwd or path may be under (after resolving symlinks); the home folder itself, ~/.ssh, ~/.orcha, ~/.metabot, ~/.claude* and <state_dir>/accounts are always refused
_max_desks: most desks in the registry at once (409 cap)
_max_runs: most live run desks at once (409 cap)
_spawn_per_minute: most spawns (desks, runs, cli desks) in any 60 s window (409 cap)
_phone_listener: the TLS listener phones pair with (Settings -> Phone, or metabot-app pair); its self-signed certificate is made once with openssl under <state_dir>/tls and pinned by each phone; false = loopback only
_phone_bind: one TLS listener per address; a paired phone's own token is the only thing that opens it, never the desktop token
_phone_addresses: addresses a pairing code advertises, tried in order by the phone, e.g. ["192.0.2.10"]; [] = this host's own non-loopback IPv4 addresses
